shiftLock.slot: COLUMN SHIFT (bench-seat trims XL/STX): shift lock slot on the STEERING COLUMN — remove the boot from the column lever to expose a small white disc; push the disc toward the passenger side to release. CONSOLE FLOOR SHIFT (bucket-seat trims, 2004+): small cap at the SIDE of the console shifter base — pry off, insert flathead, press down. Check: bench seat = column, bucket seats = console.
steps: IDENTIFY SHIFTER TYPE: column (bench seat / XL/STX) or floor console (bucket seats).
COLUMN SHIFT: Turn ignition to ON. Remove the boot covering the steering column lever.
Locate the small white disc on the column. Push it firmly toward the PASSENGER side.
While holding, press brake. Move column lever to Neutral.
CONSOLE FLOOR SHIFT (2004+ bucket seats): Turn ignition to ON.
Locate small cap at the SIDE of the console shifter base. Pry off.
Insert thin flathead into slot and press firmly downward.
While holding, press brake. Move selector to Neutral.
DEAD BATTERY (either type): restore power via jump pack — battery under hood, driver side.
Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood, driver side.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally (column lever or console selector depending on trim).
TRANSFER CASE: must be shifted to 2WD/2H before towing. IF BATTERY IS DEAD: jump battery FIRST, shift TC to 2WD, then disconnect. If TC cannot be shifted: FLATBED ONLY.

tow.method: RWD/2WD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. 4WD: transfer case to 2H first, then lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air, or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: MANUAL TRANSFER CASE (floor lever): Vehicle must be STOPPED to shift. If lever is stiff, rock vehicle slightly in neutral while applying firm pressure.
ELECTRONIC TRANSFER CASE: Requires 12V power to shift. If battery is dead, jump the battery FIRST, then shift TC to 2WD before disconnecting.
DEAD BATTERY FALLBACK: If TC cannot be shifted to 2WD, USE FLATBED. Do NOT tow with TC in 4WD/4H/4L — will destroy transfer case and driveline.
4WD DOLLY FALLBACK: If transfer case CANNOT be shifted to 2WD (dead battery, mechanical failure), either use flatbed OR wheel-lift with dollies on the opposite axle.

battery.jumpPoints: Under hood — standard red (+) / black (−) terminals
battery.warning: Confirm TC in 2WD before wheel lift.

alerts.warning: 4WD: transfer case to 2H.
alerts.notes: 4WD: transfer case MUST be in 2H before towing on road.

Pull it OUT 90° while pressing brake. Pull again to re-engage. ROTARY DIAL selector: open the center console lid; insert screwdriver into the small hole inside. Press brake and turn dial to N. CONSOLE STALK shift: small covered access panel on lower center console near shifter; pry open, YELLOW lever inside — pull toward you while pressing brake. PowerBoost: main battery under hood; aux battery under rear passenger seat.
steps: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST whenever possible — battery under hood.
IDENTIFY SHIFTER TYPE (column / rotary dial / console stalk).
COLUMN SHIFT (XL/STX, bench seat):
Locate the small horizontal panel at the BOTTOM of the steering column trim.
Pry it open — it is hinged at the bottom with spring-prong clips (flat nylon pry tool).
Behind the panel is an ORANGE lever. Pull it OUT to 90° while pressing brake.
Vehicle is now in tow/neutral mode. Pull lever again to re-engage park.
ROTARY DIAL selector:
Open the center console storage lid. Locate the small hole inside the console.
Insert screwdriver into the hole while pressing brake. Turn dial to N.
CONSOLE STALK shift:
Locate small covered access panel on lower center console near the shifter.
Pry open. YELLOW lever inside — pull it firmly toward you while pressing brake.
HYBRID (PowerBoost): main battery under hood, aux under rear passenger seat. Jump from hood.
Apply parking brake. Chock wheels.
Battery under hood — connect jump pack (PowerBoost: main battery under hood).
Restore power, press brake, shift to N using selector type.
No power: COLUMN shift — orange lever behind steering column bottom panel. ROTARY DIAL — screwdriver in console lid hole. CONSOLE STALK — yellow lever behind lower console access panel.
TRANSFER CASE: shift to 2WD/2H before towing. Jump battery FIRST if needed.
Hybrid (PowerBoost): 12V only — never touch the high-voltage battery pack.

tow.method: RWD/2WD: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. 4WD: transfer case to 2H first, then lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
notes: HYBRID/PHEV: Use 12V auxiliary battery ONLY for jumping. NEVER access the high-voltage battery pack.

issues.title: 14th Gen Multiple Shifter Types — Identify Before Proceeding
issues.detail: The 2021-2026 F-150 comes with three different shifter configurations: column (bench seat), rotary dial (console), and stalk (console). Each has a different override location. The column shift has an orange lever behind a panel at the bottom of the steering column trim. The rotary dial has a hole in the center console lid. The console stalk has a yellow lever behind a lower console access panel.

shiftLock.slot: NO CABIN SHIFT LOCK OVERRIDE in traditional sense. Electric drivetrain — FLATBED ONLY. 12V BATTERY IS IN THE FRUNK — open the front hood, battery is inside the frunk storage area (passenger side). Jump posts accessible under the passenger-side frunk cover panel. NEVER touch orange HV cables.
steps: FLATBED ONLY — electric drivetrain.
12V battery is in the FRUNK (front storage area), NOT a traditional engine bay location.
To restore 12V: open the front hood, access jump posts under the PASSENGER-SIDE frunk cover panel.
12V AUXILIARY ONLY — NEVER touch orange HV cables.

Settings > Vehicle > Tow/Haul — or press and hold N on the selector.
FLATBED ONLY — electric drivetrain.
12V battery is in the FRUNK (passenger side of frunk storage area).
Jump posts under the passenger-side frunk cover — use these for jumping.
12V AUXILIARY ONLY — NEVER touch HV orange cables.

Very heavy vehicle — confirm tow truck capacity before approach.

issues.title: 12V Battery in Frunk — Not Under Hood
issues.detail: The F-150 Lightning has NO traditional engine bay. The 12V auxiliary battery is inside the frunk storage area on the passenger side. Jump posts are under the passenger-side frunk cover panel — use these for jumping without removing the battery. Never attempt to jump from under the hood of an ICE truck for comparison — the Lightning frunk is the correct access point.

issues.title: FLATBED ONLY — Electric Drivetrain
issues.detail: The Lightning has dual electric motors driving all four wheels. Towing with any wheels on the ground will damage the motors. No exceptions — flatbed only.

issues.title: Very Heavy Vehicle
issues.detail: The F-150 Lightning weighs approximately 6,000-6,500 lbs depending on battery size. Verify your flatbed is rated for this weight. Many standard flatbeds are rated for 5,000 lbs and will be over capacity.

Shift lock slot: round access plug on the UNDERSIDE of the steering column cover — remove plug with flathead screwdriver, push the solenoid plunger upward with a tool. Requires at least partial 12V to activate solenoid. DIESEL: may have dual batteries — both under hood, driver side.
steps: COLUMN SHIFTER — all 2000-2016 Super Duty trims.
RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — battery under hood, driver side.
DIESEL: may have dual batteries — connect to primary (driver-side) battery.
Once powered: turn ignition to ON, press brake, move column lever to Neutral.
WITHOUT POWER — column shift override:
Locate the round access plug on the UNDERSIDE of the steering column cover.
Remove plug with a flathead screwdriver.
Insert screwdriver into the hole and push the solenoid plunger UPWARD while pressing brake.
Note: solenoid is electronic — partial power greatly helps; jump pack strongly recommended.
LAST RESORT (no power, solenoid won't release): disconnect shift cable at transmission, manually move transmission lever two clicks toward Neutral.
TRANSFER CASE: must be in 2WD/2H before towing. Jump battery first if TC is electronic.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood, driver side. Diesel trims may have dual batteries.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
No power: column override plug on underside of column cover — push plunger up.
TRANSFER CASE: must be shifted to 2WD/2H before towing. IF BATTERY IS DEAD: jump battery FIRST, shift TC to 2WD, then disconnect. If TC cannot be shifted: FLATBED ONLY.

Insert thin flathead into slot and press firmly downward.

DEAD BATTERY (either): restore power via jump pack — battery under hood.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — under hood.
Restore power. 2002-2010: column lever to N. 2011-2019: console cap to N.

Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.

2001-2019 — FLOOR CONSOLE CAP:

REQUIRES 12V POWER — purely electronic, dead battery requires jump first. Battery under hood.
steps: IDENTIFY GENERATION: 2007-2014 (floor stalk) or 2015+ (rotary dial).
2007-2014 — FLOOR CONSOLE STALK:
Turn ignition to ON. Locate cap near selector base. Pry off.
Insert flathead, press down. Press brake. Move to N.

RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — override is electronic and requires power.
Connect jump pack to battery under hood.

Insert a screwdriver into the slot. Press and HOLD.
Transmission selector indicator will FLASH for 3 seconds — this confirms override mode.
While indicator is still flashing: RELEASE the screwdriver, then rotate selector to N.
Vehicle enters Stay in Neutral mode for towing.
WITHOUT ANY POWER: 2015+ Edge override cannot function — jump pack is mandatory.
Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — under hood.
2007-2014: cap on console, press down, brake, move to N.

issues.title: 2015+ Edge Rotary Override Requires 12V Power
issues.detail: The 2015+ Edge uses a rotary dial selector. The shift lock override slot is on the LEFT side of the rotary dial — no label, no removable cap. The override mechanism is electronic: pressing the slot causes the transmission indicator to flash for 3 seconds, during which the selector can be rotated to N. Without 12V power this procedure does not work. Always jump the battery first on 2015+ Edge.

shiftLock.slot: Hidden under the SHIFTER BOOT material. Insert a thin flathead between the boot and the console trim at the FRONT of the shifter, gently pry up the boot material to access the slot underneath.
steps: Turn ignition to ON (do not start).
The Bronco shift lock override is hidden UNDER the shifter boot material.
Insert a thin flathead screwdriver between the boot/gaiter and the console trim at the FRONT of the shifter.
Gently pry up or peel back the boot material to expose the override slot underneath.
Insert screwdriver into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding, press the brake pedal.
Move selector from Park to Neutral.
Replace boot material.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
If power cannot be restored, use the shift lock slot above — Under the SHIFTER BOOT material — insert flathead between boot and trim ring, lift boot to expose lever.
TRANSFER CASE: must be shifted to 2WD/2H before towing. IF BATTERY IS DEAD: jump battery FIRST, shift TC to 2WD, then disconnect. If TC cannot be shifted: FLATBED ONLY.

MANUAL TRANSMISSION OPTION: If equipped with manual trans, no shift lock — depress clutch and select Neutral. No override slot needed.
4WD DOLLY FALLBACK: If transfer case CANNOT be shifted to 2WD (dead battery, mechanical failure), either use flatbed OR wheel-lift with dollies on the opposite axle.
